verdict.rationale:
Mem0's core value prop is exactly this: storing facts from past conversations and retrieving them by query, scoped per user/agent/session, so an agent can recall prior context and continue where it left off (mem0-docs-6, mem0-docs-7, mem0-docs-30, mem0-docs-26). Entity-scoped memory and graph memory let an agent reconstruct 'what do we know about X' across many past sessions (mem0-docs-29, mem0-docs-38).
Missing for 10: no explicit 'session summary' generation feature (only fact-level storage/retrieval, not narrative summaries), and no independent benchmark or hands-on report validating quality of cross-session continuity beyond vendor docs.
